acceptance: Site ci keeps inventory/core-linked-paths.json (core paths linked by relative link from site docs, with source file:line) current. A core PR check inside an existing required job fails when a listed path is missing from the PR tree and prints the site file:line and the rename ordering. Seeded tests in both repos show this; core stays JS-free and the site stays Python-free.
context: Review 2026-10-28: VALID. description: A core PR that deletes a file linked from a site-owned page passes core CI and site CI, then fails the site build gate at deploy. Observed on 2026-10-27: after core PR 3545 merged, the site converter rejected development/adr/adr-sqlglot-use-and-non-use.md:218 (link to the deleted scripts/generate_compat_docs.py), and production deploys 40602921344 and 40603742160 failed at the build gate (nothing deployed; fixed in site PR 74). Site CI only builds against bundles that already merged, and core's retired link checker no longer covers site pages.
